items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 Analytics 營收年增率指引，因大型 implementation 認列的 nonrecurring 收入不會重複，預期回落到中個位數
items.quote: Analytics year-over-year revenue growth to be roughly 5%
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 表示因 ABF（asset-based fee）表現強勁及假設下半年市場溫和上漲，全年費用預計落在guidance區間的上半段
items.quote: in the top half of our expense guidance range.
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 給出 Q2 有效稅率區間指引
items.quote: we expect to have an effective tax rate between 18% and 20%.
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 重申全年自由現金流展望維持不變，但提醒 Q2 是季節性現金稅支出最高的季度
items.quote: The free cash flow outlook for the full year is unchanged
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明因收購案的無形資產攤銷，上修全年 D&A（折舊攤銷）guidance
items.quote: we updated our full year outlook on D&A by $5 million
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 定義 Q1 asset-based fee（依資產規模計費）run rate 成長率為 25%，並說明是被指數連結資金流帶動
items.quote: Asset-based fee run rate growth was 25%
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明 Analytics 收入成長逾 10%，是因本季認列較高的 implementation 一次性（非經常性）收入
items.quote: implementations recognized in nonrecurring revenues
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 被問及 AI 是否改變 Analytics 業務的競爭態勢時，回答目前尚未看到來自傳統對手或新創的激烈競爭
items.quote: haven't seen any kind of competition or intense competition
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 補充公司並未因此放鬆，仍在密切監控該競爭動態
items.quote: We're not relaxed, we're monitoring and focused on that
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示在 sustainability（永續評等）領域正從競爭對手手中搶下顯著市占
items.quote: taking away from competitors on sustainability.
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 揭露年初至今的庫藏股買回金額
items.quote: we repurchased more than $464 million of MSCI shares
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 提到近期完成三筆小型併購案（bolt-on acquisition），鎖定關鍵成長領域
items.quote: small bolt-on acquisitions in key growth areas
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 說明三筆併購案（Vantager、Compass、PM Insights）對 run rate 與費用的貢獻相對有限
items.quote: a relatively modest contribution to run rate
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 表示 IndexAI Insights 連接器自二月底推出以來，已有數百家客戶使用
items.quote: used IndexAI Insights since our launch in late February
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 提到收購 Compass Financial Technologies，把客製化指數能力延伸到商品、數位資產、股票衍生品等新資產類別
items.quote: acquisition of Compass Financial Technologies
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 提到公司已推出 active financial product license，讓客戶用 MSCI 指數運算能力做主動型 ETF，能同時挹注訂閱與 ABF 兩種收入
items.quote: we have launched our active financial product license.
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 預期 Sustainability 與 Climate 產品線的需求壓力與成長趨緩會持續到近期
items.quote: Sustainability and Climate to continue in the near term.
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 提到 Real Assets 產品線的不動產交易解決方案仍面臨逆風
items.quote: headwinds with our property transaction solutions
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 被問及市場動盪是否影響業務時，表示除了波灣地區的商談與展示放緩，其他地區未見伊朗戰爭的影響，客戶維持正常營運節奏
items.quote: effect of the Iran war anywhere else in the world.
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 說明 Index 產品線在對沖基金客群的訂閱 run rate 成長率達 27%
items.quote: run rate growth within index with hedge funds
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: 分析師指出資產管理公司客群訂閱 run rate 成長率從上季 7% 降到本季 6%，詢問後續動能
items.quote: it moderated a bit from 7%, I believe, last quarter to 6%
items.speaker: Ashish Sabadra (Analyst)

items.claim: CFO 回應資產管理公司成長率變動時，提到匯率因素會影響任一客群的成長率數字
items.quote: FX factors at play with the growth rates
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 回答私募信貸市場的信用風險疑慮對 PCS（私募資產解決方案）業務是順風而非逆風
items.quote: It's definitely a tailwind for us.
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 重申公司致力於透過紀律化部署超額資本來極大化價值創造
items.quote: we are committed to maximizing value creation
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 透露約一年半前公司已把使用 AI 列為聘用員工的條件之一，藉此推動全公司 AI 採用
items.quote: we made AI a condition of employment at MSCI.
items.speaker: Henry Fernandez (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 給出第三季 adjusted EBITDA 費用區間，因遣散費及 AUM 連動薪酬墊高
items.quote: the high $330 million
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 預告全年費用可能落在原先財測區間的高端
items.quote: the higher end of our expense ranges
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明年初至今 recurring net new 較去年同期成長幅度
items.quote: up 24%, 25% over last year
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 量化 BlackRock 新約對基點費率的兩階段調整幅度
items.quote: to the basis point fees was 0.1 basis point adjustment
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 定義 AI 帶來的效益是把 run-the-business 費用成長率壓到低個位數
items.quote: bring that down to low single-digit type of growth rates
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 拆解 Q1 到 Q2 基點費率下滑的口徑，歸因於低費率大型 ETF 產品的資產成長
items.quote: extraordinary growth in lower fee hyperscale ETFs
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 表示公司在爭取新流入 ETF 資產的市佔上具備獨特位置
items.quote: capture a significant amount of the market share
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 定調併購策略聚焦於加速既有業務的小型收購，不追求新事業線
items.quote: will likely be bolt-on accelerators
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 重申會持續在具吸引力價位大力執行庫藏股買回
items.quote: buy our stock back at attractive prices
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 給出新產品對今年上半年新增經常性銷售的貢獻比例
items.quote: 40% from new products
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 指出 Index 部門經常性訂閱成長率因新產品加速
items.quote: accelerate from mid-8% to over 11%
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明 Private Assets 旗下 PCS（原 Burgiss）業務訂閱成長率最新一季的加速幅度
items.quote: up to north of 16% in the most recent quarter
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 針對 Analytics 與 Sustainability 業務被 AI 顛覆的疑慮，明確表態 AI 現階段是機會而非威脅
items.quote: we don't today see AI as a threat but more of an opportunity
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 列舉過去一年在 broker-dealer 客群也出現成長加速
items.quote: We've seen acceleration with broker-dealers.
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 描述傳統主動式資產管理客群是預算壓力最集中之處
items.quote: is kind of the epicenter of that pressure
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 承諾公司財務目標是加速獲利與自由現金流成長，而非單純衝高利潤率
items.quote: drive faster profitability and free cash flow growth
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明即使完成多筆併購，過去一年整體人力仍維持大致持平
items.quote: our headcount has been roughly flat
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 承諾把 AI 節省下來的費用再投資，而不是直接讓利潤率跳升
items.quote: to reinvest them and accelerate that algorithm
items.speaker: Andrew Wiechmann (CFO)

qa_flags.question: 分析師追問遣散費是否集中在特定事業部門，還是廣泛分布
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 先說主要落在 data/technology 與 Analytics、Index 等大部門，但隨即表示「I don't want to be too specific at this point」，未給出具體部門別數字或比例
